info.name: The Nependeath Juice
info.parent: The Chaos behind Alfonse Green and the Nependeath Juice

descriptions.notStarted: I should go see Alfonse Green, who should be somewhere near Orbis.
descriptions.inProgress: I met up with Alfonse Green, and needless to say, he is a big fan of the Nependeath Juice. He asked me if I could make one for him. To make one, I'll need to acquire the Sap of Nependeath, and I'll need Ericsson for that.
